name: Window-wide keyboard shortcuts
body:
# Window-wide shortcuts

Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, Y, D, A, N, O, Delete, F, W/E/R and Escape work wherever the pointer is, through an
`onKeyDown` on the app root that receives modifier-qualified key names (`"Shortcut+s"`), and a focused text field keeps
the keys it uses. The viewport keeps reading held keys for flying. Depends on `GAME-F02-T06` and the chaos card
"Modifier-qualified key names and onKeyUp".

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. Root onKeyDown/onKeyUp in App.chaos; HandleKey in EditorApplication.nyx owns the application shortcuts and forwards the rest to the viewport through editorKey with modifier bits. Decision D-034.
